question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

The deal was ________ for three months.
solution:
The correct answer is: **put on ice**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"put on ice"** means to delay or postpone something. (स्थगित करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The project was **put on ice** until we received further funding.
 
 
 
• The deal was delayed or postponed for three months, hence the correct idiom is "**put on ice**".

**​**Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

**Complete Sentence:** *The deal was put on ice__ for three months.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cut no ice** (कोई प्रभाव नहीं डालना): To have no influence or effect.

 
 
• **Example:** His excuses **cut no ice** with the teacher.
 
 
 
• **Broken the ice** (बातचीत शुरू करना): To initiate conversation in a social setting.
 
 
• **Example:** She **broke the ice** by telling a joke at the beginning of the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Tipped of the iceberg** (बर्फ की नोक): To indicate that a small, visible part of a larger problem or issue.
 
 
• **Example:** The financial losses are just the **tip of the iceberg**; the company is facing much bigger problems.
